attribution: European Commission JRC GHS-POP; Kummu et al.; Jones et al. GCP-GridFED; Li, Zhou, Zhao & Zhao; Natural Earth
transformations: 30-arcsecond classification with the existing Mundus country ownership and coastal fallback
Area-weighted country aggregation of the published 2020 source snapshots
Offline JS GSM2018 flow with bounded residual-density corrections
MRE3 uniform 1024×512 periodic node inverse; Int16 delta longitude and sine latitude, meshopt vertex encoding
Lossless country JSON metadata; budgets measured with gzip level 6
Spherical 8-neighbour chamfer selects the intended solid core; country ID in R, stable metric padding bits in G, reserved B=0
missingValuePolicy: Missing is null; true zero uses 0.01 mean density; ocean, Antarctica and missing receive mean density.
boundaryPolicy: Existing Mundus full-detail country policy; the retained admin-1 classification preserves coastal label ties but only country records are published.
coverageNote: 239 named countries; 2020 global snapshots; unreconciled source cells remain explicitly unassigned.

sources.name: Kummu et al. downscaled GDP v4

population.selection: Single float64 population-count band, epoch 2020; this published file has no nodata tag and declares 100% valid cells. Preserve its shifted 30-arcsecond affine grid and map by pixel centres.

gdp.selection: Band whose GDAL description is 2020; 2021 international dollars (PPP), as explicitly stated by v4 metadata.

co2.selection: Twelve months; CO2 oil, coal, gas and cement calcination; exclude bunkers and cement carbonation; inspect variable units before conversion to tonnes CO2/year.

lights.selection: DN sum, relative index, 0-63; not radiance.

admin1.selection: Full-detail admin-1; name and name_zh; Mundus raster reassignment policy.

chn.selection: Full-detail China boundary view combined through the existing mundusCountryFeatures boundary policy.

default.selection: Full-detail default boundary view combined through the existing mundusCountryFeatures boundary policy.

metadata.conversion: sum 12 months and OIL/GAS/COAL/CEMENT then divide kg by 1000
